plays.desc_ko: 경기 초반 BLG(매치 포인트로 앞선 팀)가 바텀과 미드에서 라인 푸시(주도권)를 가져가고 있다는 해설. 구체적 전투 없음.
plays.desc_en: Early on, BLG, leading the series at match point, holds lane priority by pushing in bot and mid. No fighting takes place.
plays.quote: They're getting the push in bot. ... They're getting the push in mid

plays.desc_ko: Ruler(자야)가 바텀에서 Viper를 상대로 퍼스트 블러드를 따냄. 실황은 '솔로 킬'로 표현; 이후 리플레이에서 앵글을 잡고 점멸로 파고들어 W 추가 피해, Duro의 점멸 진입 슬로우, Viper의 정화 후 점멸 없이 깃털에 맞아 사망하는 과정 설명.
plays.desc_en: Ruler (Xayah) takes First Blood on Viper in the bot lane. He finds an angle and flashes in for extra Deadly Plumage damage, Duro flashes in with a slow, and Viper cleanses but, without Flash, dies to the returning feathers.
plays.quote: THE FIRST BLOOD FROM RULER ON THE ... ANOTHER SOLO FROM RULER ONTO VIPER. ... flash in from Duro, applies the slow,

plays.desc_ko: 미드에서 Knight(트위스티드 페이트)가 골드 카드(스턴)로 Chovy를 노려 점멸을 강제. 후속 연계를 피하려 Chovy가 점멸 사용.
plays.desc_en: In mid, Knight (Twisted Fate) looks for Chovy with a Gold Card stun, and Chovy burns Flash to avoid the follow-up.
plays.quote: Another goal card ... does force the flash.

plays.desc_ko: 탑에서 Bin이 점멸을 쓴 뒤 Xun(녹턴)이 Kiin(오로라)에게 갱킹. 녹턴이 점멸로 따라붙었으나 4레벨 Xun 혼자서는 딜이 부족해 Kiin이 걸어서 빠져나감. 양 탑라이너 모두 점멸 소모.
plays.desc_en: After Bin uses Flash, Xun (Nocturne) ganks Kiin (Aurora) and flashes to stay on him, but a level-4 Xun lacks the damage alone and Kiin walks away. Both top laners have now used Flash.
plays.quote: victim of Shun's gank. ... not enough damage from just Shun at ... early on Noturn and Keen still walks it

plays.desc_ko: Ruler가 바텀에서 다시 ON/Viper 쪽으로 파고들어 두 번째 킬을 획득. Viper는 도주 시도.
plays.desc_en: Ruler dives into ON and Viper in the bot lane again and picks up a second kill as Viper tries to escape.
plays.quote: He's going in yet ... RULER LOOKING FOR EVEN MORE. HE'S FOUND ... A SECOND. RULER REFUSES TO BACK DOWN.

plays.desc_ko: Bin(그웬)이 니들워크로 6레벨 전인 Kiin(오로라)을 노리고, Kiin의 궁극기 부재를 활용. Knight가 첫 TF 궁극기로 합류, Bin이 Kiin을 처치한 뒤 미니언 사이로 빠져나감. BLG가 탑에서 한 킬 만회.
plays.desc_en: Bin (Gwen) uses Needlework on a pre-6 Kiin (Aurora) who has no ultimate. Knight joins with his first Destiny, and Bin kills Kiin before slipping out through the minions, getting a kill back in top.
plays.quote: Ben going in here with the needle work ... Knight shows up ... BEN CUTS HIM DOWN WITH

plays.desc_ko: Knight가 제어 와드를 유지하기 위한 심리전 시야 플레이. Canyon이 해당 부쉬를 확인하지 않도록 유도했다는 해설(앞부분 일부 마스킹).
plays.desc_en: Knight plays a vision mind game to keep his Control Ward alive, steering Canyon away from checking that brush.
plays.quote: bit of a mind game play there from ... that control ward.

plays.desc_ko: Xun(녹턴)이 귀환하려다 취소하고 블루 버프와 칼날부리(그롬프)를 챙김. 첫 궁극기 쿨다운 감소 목적이라는 해설.
plays.desc_en: Xun (Nocturne) cancels his recall to take Blue Buff and Gromp, aiming to lower his first ultimate cooldown.
plays.quote: Oh, he's actually canceling it. Sticking ... around for the blue buff ... blue and Gromp.

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 공허 유충(그럽) 사냥을 시작해 첫 그럽을 가져감. 이후 '첫 드래곤, 첫 그럽 모두 GEN' 회고.
plays.desc_en: GEN starts on the Void Grubs and secures the first one. Casters later note that GEN took both the first dragon and the first grubs.
plays.quote: Geng starting up the grubs ... First dragon, first grubs ... going their way.

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 그럽 교전을 포기하고 Viper(유나라)를 바텀으로 돌려보냄.
plays.desc_en: BLG gives up the grub fight and sends Viper (Yunara) back to the bot lane.
plays.quote: sending actually Viper back bottom. ... intention of fighting the grubs this

plays.desc_ko: Chovy가 부쉬에 앉아 로밍 기회를 엿보지만, 팀이 탑 쪽에 있어 ON에게 들어가는 것은 위험하다고 판단해 진입하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Chovy waits in a brush looking for a roam, but with his team over by top he judges going in on ON too risky and holds back.
plays.quote: Chi sitting in the brush ... Yeah, he's not going to commit onto on

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 첫 드래곤을 가져갔다는 회고 언급. 실시간 서술은 없음(앞선 S0285-S0291 마스킹 구간과 '초반 드래곤 투자' 언급만 존재).
plays.desc_en: GEN is noted in retrospect to have taken the first dragon. There is no live call of the take.
plays.quote: of objectives. First dragon, first grubs

plays.desc_ko: 두 번째 드래곤 생성 약 45초 전 Ruler가 귀환(베이스).
plays.desc_en: Ruler recalls about 45 seconds before the second dragon spawns.
plays.quote: going to see a base come out from Ruler.

plays.desc_ko: Knight의 첫 움직임이 탑 쪽으로 향해 잠시 맴돌았으나 Kiin이 점멸을 보유(이후 문장 마스킹).
plays.desc_en: Knight's first move heads toward top and he hovers there briefly, but Kiin still has Flash.
plays.quote: mean, the first move from Knight was ... towards top lane. He hovers a little bit

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 바텀 다이브: Canyon(판테온) 대격변(Grand Starfall)으로 Viper를 노려 즉사시킴. Knight가 늦게 합류, Canyon은 실드로 빠져나감. 양 팀 여러 명 합류했지만 GEN이 목적 달성.
plays.desc_en: GEN dives bot as Canyon (Pantheon) lands Grand Starfall on Viper and kills him instantly. Knight arrives late and Canyon escapes with his shield. Several players from both teams join, but GEN gets what it wanted.
plays.quote: Comes your dive. There it is. Grand ... Starfall Viper is the target. ... walking away with what they came for.

plays.desc_ko: Xun이 다이브를 예상하고 바텀으로 이동, Knight가 TF 궁극기로 합류했으나 너무 늦음. 녹턴 공포가 걸렸지만 후속 딜 부족. 이후 '두 번째 궁극기는 바텀 방어용으로 쓰였지만 킬을 못 땄다'는 회고.
plays.desc_en: Xun anticipates the dive and moves bot, and Knight joins with Destiny, but too late. Nocturne's fear lands without enough follow-up damage, and casters later note that the second ultimate was spent defending bot without getting a kill.
plays.quote: Knight shows up, but ... he's a little bit too late. ... The fear will proc, but there's

plays.desc_ko: Bin이 탑에서 니들워크로 Kiin에게 강하게 딜교환 시도. Kiin이 오로라 궁극기(Between Worlds)로 대응, Bin은 일부 피해를 피하며 빠져나가려 함.
plays.desc_en: Bin trades hard into Kiin with Needlework. Kiin answers with Between Worlds, and Bin dodges some of the damage while trying to get out.
plays.quote: Ben committing needle work up here in ... heavily into Keen between worlds going ... sidesteps some of the damage.

plays.desc_ko: Chovy(아칼리)가 탑으로 로밍해 오연투(five-point strike)를 맞히고 Bin의 점멸을 빼냄. 바텀에서 한 명 잃은 데 대한 만회 성격이라는 해설.
plays.desc_en: Chovy (Akali) roams top, lands Perfect Execution and forces Bin's Flash. Casters frame it as a way to make up for the loss in bot.
plays.quote: Chovi is rotating forward. Hits the ... five-point strike. Forces the flash out ... it's Chovi roaming towards the top side.

plays.desc_ko: Knight가 카드를 고르며 대기하다 탑 Kiin을 노려 전진, TF 궁극기 없이 딜교환에서 Kiin의 점멸을 빼냄. 이어 '패러노이아를 돌린다'는 언급(맥락 불명).
plays.desc_en: Knight waits while picking a card, then steps up on Kiin in top and forces his Flash in a trade without using Destiny. A Paranoia mention follows, though the context is unclear.
plays.quote: Knight just waiting, flipping through ... steps forward, wants to try to go after ... flash at the Keen in trade.

plays.desc_ko: Canyon과 Duro가 협력해 바텀 강가 입구 시야를 정리.
plays.desc_en: Canyon and Duro work together to clear vision at the bot river entrance.
plays.quote: the alt of his own. Working with Duro ... well to clear out the entrance vision ... towards the botside river.

plays.desc_ko: Ruler가 두 명의 보호를 받으며 미드로 이동, Canyon·Duro가 반대편 시야 확보. GEN이 자야를 앞세워 전령을 강제하려 회전했으나 Bin의 텔레포트 합류에 물러남.
plays.desc_en: Ruler moves mid with two escorts while Canyon and Duro secure vision on the other side. GEN rotates behind Xayah to force the Herald, but backs off when Bin teleports in.
plays.quote: Ruler in the mid lane. This time ... and it's going to be Geng rotating over ... force this objective.

plays.desc_ko: Xun 분신으로 바나나 부쉬 정찰, Bin 텔레포트 합류(실드), TF 궁극기는 시야용 사용. ON의 개화(궁극기)가 두 명에게 적중해 Kiin에 큰 피해, Kiin 집중해 처치. 이후 Ruler를 노려 후방 다이브, 파멸의 호(Arc of Ruin)로 둔화시켰으나 후속 없음. 리플레이: Bin이 이니시, Xun 강타 후 ON 궁 두 명 적중.
plays.desc_en: Xun scouts the banana brush with his clone, Bin teleports in with a shield, and Knight uses Destiny for vision. ON's Pop Blossom hits two and deals heavy damage to Kiin, whom BLG focuses down. BLG then dives the backline for Ruler and slows him with Arc of Ruin, but has no follow-up.
plays.quote: HE FINDS THE POP BLOSSOM. SO MUCH DAMAGE ... DOWN ONTO THE TOP LANER AS KEEN IS ... THERE'S NO FOLLOW up for the rest of

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 ON의 진입과 동시에 협곡의 전령을 처치, ON이 전령을 획득. GEN이 장악하던 초반 흐름에서 전령을 빼앗았다는 평가.
plays.desc_en: BLG kills the Rift Herald just as ON engages, and ON secures it. Casters call it a Herald taken away from GEN during its early control of the game.
plays.quote: going to be slain by BLG as on goes in. ... They do manage to claim the Uber Eats ... they're able to steal away that

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 더 추격하려 할 때 측면에 남아 있던 Chovy가 후방을 위협하며 킬 하나를 되갚음(1대1).
plays.desc_en: As BLG tries to chase further, Chovy threatens the backline from the flank and trades a kill back, leaving it 1-for-1.
plays.quote: It's a one for one ... trades it back as he's still sitting on ... able to answer one of the kills.

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 드래곤을 추가로 가져가 영혼 포인트(3번째 드래곤)에 도달했다는 언급. 해당 드래곤 처치 실황은 없음.
plays.desc_en: GEN is noted to have taken another dragon, reaching soul point with its third. The take itself is not called live.
plays.quote: Genji though acquiring soul point. One ... more drake and they will have that big

plays.desc_ko: ON이 개화로 전진해 두 명을 맞히고 Ruler의 궁극기를 빼냄. Duro는 점멸로 이탈, Ruler가 표적이 되지만 깃털로 버티고 와일드카드는 빗나감. 다시 들어온 Canyon과 Chovy를 BLG가 처치, Viper가 전세를 뒤집어 2킬.
plays.desc_en: ON steps forward with Pop Blossom, hits two and draws out Ruler's ultimate. Duro flashes away, and Ruler survives being targeted with his feathers as Wild Cards miss. BLG kills Canyon and Chovy when they re-engage, and Viper turns the fight for two kills.
plays.quote: On going forward for the pop loss ... and finds TWO AND FORCES THE ULTI BACK ... CANYON AND TOBY TRY AND GO BACK IN AND

plays.desc_ko: Chovy가 궁극기로 진입(암살), ON이 Ruler의 칼날을 피하자 Chovy가 점멸로 들어가 Neeko 처치. 이후 Canyon·Chovy가 다시 들어갔으나 Canyon의 Q가 빗나가며 둘 다 사망.
plays.desc_en: Chovy goes in with his ultimate, and after ON dodges Ruler's blades, Chovy flashes in to kill Neeko. Canyon and Chovy then re-engage, but Canyon's Q misses and both die.
plays.quote: CANYON AND TOBY TRY AND GO BACK IN AND ... the Q. Canyon misses such an important ... flashing forward to get that kill onto

plays.desc_ko: 대치 상황에서 BLG가 사이드 라인을 밀고 회전해 미니언 웨이브를 완전히 장악.
plays.desc_en: During the standoff, BLG pushes the side lanes and rotates to take full control of the minion waves.
plays.quote: job. They push out on the side lane, ... control the minion wave.

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 영혼 드래곤 대비 바나나 부쉬와 측면에 제어 와드 설치.
plays.desc_en: GEN places Control Wards in the banana brush and the flanks to prepare for the soul dragon.
plays.quote: Gen control ward there in the banana

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 미드 부쉬의 GEN 와드를 즉시 제거하고 교전 준비.
plays.desc_en: BLG immediately clears GEN's ward in the mid brush and gets ready to fight.
plays.quote: lane brush going to be removed ... immediately by BLG who are ready to try

plays.desc_ko: 화학공학 영혼 드래곤 앞 대치: Bin이 바텀으로 텔레포트, BLG가 드래곤 근처에서 영혼 획득 저지에 집중. Xun 패러노이아 사용, Canyon은 뒤로 밀려나고 Chovy는 존야로 버팀. BLG가 무리하지 않고 드래곤을 가져가 GEN 영혼을 저지, 킬 교환 없이 빠짐.
plays.desc_en: In the standoff at the Chemtech soul dragon, Bin teleports bot and BLG focuses on denying the soul. Xun uses Paranoia, Canyon is pushed back and Chovy holds on with Zhonya's. BLG takes the dragon without overcommitting, denying GEN the soul and leaving with no kills traded.
plays.quote: Bin already teleporting down ... BLG near the drake wanting to ... Paranoia is going to turn out the light.

plays.desc_ko: Chovy가 시선을 끌어 팀이 싸울 공간을 만들려고 진입해 시간을 벌었으나 BLG가 과투자하지 않고 드래곤을 가져감. Chovy는 연막/존야로 생존.
plays.desc_en: Chovy engages to draw attention and create space for his team, buying time, but BLG doesn't overcommit and takes the dragon. Chovy survives with his shroud and Zhonya's.
plays.quote: as Chovi hides inside the smoke. Hides ... simply never happens. Chovi engages to ... draw attention towards himself, to open

plays.desc_ko: Knight가 바론 둥지 주변 시야를 제거. 삼거리 부쉬에서 Chovy('Joy')와 마주쳤으나 Chovy가 싸움을 피함.
plays.desc_en: Knight clears vision around the Baron pit. He runs into Chovy in the tri-brush, but Chovy avoids the fight.
plays.quote: turrets for BLG as Knight moves to ... remove some of the vision around the ... Baron pit. Joy does meet him there in

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 탑 사이드에서 Knight로 라인을 밀어냄.
plays.desc_en: BLG pushes out the top side lane with Knight.
plays.quote: been able to get the push out on top ... side there for Knight.

plays.desc_ko: 바텀 사이드에서 Kiin이 미니언 웨이브를 타워까지 밀어 넣음. GEN은 제어 와드·푸른 장신구가 없어 조심해야 한다는 해설, 같은 쪽에 Bin(그웬) 존재.
plays.desc_en: Kiin shoves the bot side wave into the tower. Casters warn that GEN has no Control Wards or Oracle Lens and must be careful, with Bin (Gwen) on the same side.
plays.quote: bottom side. Keane gets a minion wave ... all the way to the tower.

plays.desc_ko: BLG의 패러노이아(녹턴 궁극기) 함정을 피하기 위해 Duro가 룰루 궁극기(급성장)를 써야 했다는 회고. 상세 장면은 마스킹 구간(S0808-S0812).
plays.desc_en: Casters note in retrospect that Duro had to use Wild Growth to escape BLG's Paranoia trap.
plays.quote: wild growth from Duro that had to be ... committed to get away from the paranoia

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 바론을 시작해 계속 공략. Ruler가 이미 체력 절반 손실. BLG의 교전으로 바론을 빼앗김.
plays.desc_en: GEN starts Baron and keeps hitting it, with Ruler already down half his health, but BLG's engage takes the Baron away from them.
plays.quote: Genji still staying committed here to ... the Baron. Ruler's already lost about ... damage inside the Baron pit.

plays.desc_ko: Xun이 전진, Viper의 파멸의 호, ON의 3인 개화 적중. Ruler가 깃털 폭풍으로 빠지려다 Bin에게 추격당해 사망, Chovy도 스턴 후 사망. BLG 3대1 교전 승리.
plays.desc_en: Xun steps forward, Viper lands Arc of Ruin and ON hits three with Pop Blossom. Ruler tries to escape with Featherstorm but Bin chases him down, and Chovy is stunned and killed. BLG wins the fight 3-for-1.
plays.quote: Ruin fired OFF BY V. OH, AR GOES IN FOR ... THE THREEMAN POP BLOSSOM. RULER ... HUNTED AND CUT DOWN BY BEN. GENJI ARE

plays.desc_ko: 교전 승리 후 BLG가 바론 확보, 매치 포인트 상황.
plays.desc_en: After winning the fight, BLG secures Baron while at match point.
plays.quote: THEY'LL TAKE THE BARON, TOO. ... SECURE THE BARON MATCH POINT AT the

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 추격 지속: Knight가 텔레포트(데스티니)로 합류해 Chovy를 스턴, Duro 빈사, Viper 후속, Xun이 킬. Ruler도 거의 죽을 뻔하며 겨우 생존.
plays.desc_en: BLG keeps chasing. Knight joins with Destiny and stuns Chovy, Duro is left near death, Viper follows up and Xun gets the kill. Ruler barely survives.
plays.quote: BLG CONTINUE THE CHASE. ... KNIGHT MAKES THE TELEPORT INTO THE FIGHT ... THERE. SHAN TAKES THE KILL.

plays.desc_ko: Chovy를 드래곤에서 밀어내고 BLG가 드래곤 확보.
plays.desc_en: BLG pushes Chovy off the dragon and secures it.
plays.quote: Chovi zoned away from the dragon. But ... this is another objective secured for

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 타워 아래로 다이브해 GEN 선수들을 하나씩 처치.
plays.desc_en: BLG dives under the tower and picks off GEN players one by one.
plays.quote: diving underneath the tower. They take ... down the Genji members one at a time and

plays.desc_ko: Knight가 미드에서 협공(pincer)으로 다음 구조물 공략을 준비. 이후 'BLG가 아직 기지를 부수지 못했다' 언급.
plays.desc_en: Knight sets up a pincer in mid to go after the next structure. Casters then note that BLG still hasn't broken the base.
plays.quote: Well, Knight's actually busy over in ... mid, providing the Pinser attack to set

plays.desc_ko: 상대 궁극기·점멸이 없는 상황에서 Knight가 사이드 라이너 Bin을 위해 갱킹하러 이동.
plays.desc_en: With the enemy ultimates and Flashes down, Knight moves to gank for side laner Bin.
plays.quote: alt, no flash. Knight going to gank for ... their side laner for Bin.

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 자기 정글에 있던 Xun을 기습하려 해 Xun이 패러노이아를 방어적으로 사용. Ruler가 녹턴 궁극기를 강제하고 칼날부리(그롬프)를 빼앗음.
plays.desc_en: GEN tries to ambush Xun in its own jungle, and Xun uses Paranoia defensively. Ruler forces out Nocturne's ultimate and steals Gromp.
plays.quote: now Shun has to use Paranoia defensively ... as Genji try to catch him unaware in his ... he forces the Noctturn ultimate. And it

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 바론을 시작, 교전 중 Canyon이 바론을 처치(해설은 '또 하나의 후반 오브젝트를 훔쳤다'고 표현). 이후 GEN은 남은 인원을 귀환시킴.
